picks.file: Castello di Ferrara - Château de Ferrare (BM 1982,U.635).jpg
picks.why: strongest view of the city’s main landmark; margins and caption trimmed

gaps: P0: only a Nuremberg Chronicle council scene, not a view. P1: the 1617 bird’s-eye view (#4) is photographed as an open two-page spread with the gutter through the city; the 1520 ‘Veduta di città’ panels are ideal-city paintings, not Ferrara. P2: the 17th-century etching (#5) is plan-like and only dated ‘17th century’. P5: the only hit is the Swiss Val Ferrera (wrong place). P6: only casual snapshots of the castle moat and a cannon.
notes: #6 (1845) and #8 (1850) show the same castle but fall in different periods; #7 and #9 are flat architectural elevations of the cathedral, not views. #4 would be a good P1 view if an unbound scan of the same plate turns up.
